newsitem.title: USA: Zions Bancorp to buy Sky Valley Bank.
newsitem.headline: Zions Bancorp to buy Sky Valley Bank.

text.p: Zions Bancorp and Sky Valley Bank Corp said on Friday that the two companies reached an agreement for Sky Valley to merge into Zions in a $20.3 million stock swap.
The First National Bank in Alamosa, the subsidiary of Sky Valley, has approximately $120 million in assets in three offices in southern Colorado.
The merger is subject to the approval of Sky Valley shareholders and banking regulators and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997, the companies said in a joint statement.
Zions agreed to issue 573,134 shares for all of Sky Valley, which is valued at 2.7 times book value under this deal, the companies said.
